evidence.quote: it isn’t – it’s on Thursday.

explanations.text: 短信把训练日期从Wednesday更正为Thursday，因此是通知计划改变；并未取消训练，也不是首次邀请。

evidence.quote: Hear how he got ideas for his books

explanations.text: Meet与Hear说明活动是见作者并听他讲书籍创作灵感；没有提到售书，也不是让学生阅读探险故事。

evidence.quote: Tickets are available for $4

explanations.text: Tickets are available表明现在可以买票；票价已包含大巴和门票，因此无需选择交通方式或询问是否需要票。

evidence.quote: I think I left my scarf in your flat after the party. Have you seen it?

explanations.text: Lizzie询问聚会后遗落的围巾是否在Jenny家；买新的只是找不到时的打算。

evidence.quote: Can I use yours? I’ll give it back in maths tomorrow.

explanations.text: Can I use yours与give it back说明想借球拍；最后提作业只是顺带聊天，不是主要请求。

evidence.quote: Class 3, at 9 am, please go and join Class 4 in Room 7C for geography.

explanations.text: Class 3要加入Class 4在7C上课，所以今天教室人数比平时多；通知没有改变Class 4上课时间，也没有说明取消明天课程。

evidence.quote: she often appears on TV, talking about tennis matches at major competitions.

explanations.text: Tracy现在在电视上讲解重要网球赛事，对应题目所指的媒体工作。

evidence.quote: she helped large numbers of people become interested in gymnastics.

explanations.text: Nadia的表现让更多人喜欢体操，对应让这项运动更受欢迎。

evidence.quote: she was 15 and still too young to drive

explanations.text: Tracy赢得汽车时只有15岁，年龄不足以开车，所以奖品当时不能使用。

evidence.quote: at the age of 17, the American became the youngest ever sports person to earn a million dollars.

explanations.text: 17岁赚到一百万美元说明Tracy年少时就变得富有。

evidence.quote: she was the only under-14-year-old to take part in the 2016 Olympics

explanations.text: Gaurika是该届奥运会唯一不足14岁的选手，因此是最年轻的参赛者。

evidence.quote: Everyone thought that nobody could do this

explanations.text: 这句话指Nadia取得10.0满分；此前人们认为无人能做到。

evidence.quote: Gaurika is from Nepal

explanations.text: Gaurika来自尼泊尔，而文章另说如今家在英国，对应出生国与居住国不同。

evidence.quote: But not everyone opens their own company.

explanations.text: 前两句说年少有爱好或职业打算很常见；转折后强调开公司才是不寻常之处。

evidence.quote: these colours helped her to think of new clothes which she could make.

explanations.text: 画画时使用的颜色启发了服装设计，不是直接把颜料涂到衣服上。

evidence.quote: she has made one room into an office, and another into a studio

explanations.text: 把不同房间改成办公室和工作室表明她为在家工作改造了房间。

evidence.quote: Above all, she really knows what is needed to succeed in the world of fashion.

explanations.text: Above all之后给出作者最重要的判断依据：她懂得在时尚行业成功需要什么。

evidence.quote: Isabella just made clothes for fun. But people liked her designs, so soon she started selling them online.

explanations.text: 全文描述她从兴趣制衣发展为经营公司，因此标题应概括爱好变职业。

evidence.quote: because there weren’t any other pupils

explanations.text: 没有其他学生导致学校必须关闭，close表示停办；complete与finish不表示学校停止营业。

evidence.quote: it is small

explanations.text: 小船只能在好天气使用，only表示限制；almost/nearly表示几乎，与条件限制不符。

evidence.quote: A much larger boat is (21) ........ in bad weather.

explanations.text: 恶劣天气需要更大的船，is needed构成被动语态；liked与had不符合语义。

evidence.quote: the ferry across the sea

explanations.text: catch the ferry表示赶乘渡船，是本句需要的动宾搭配。

evidence.quote: the night at a friend’s house instead

explanations.text: stay the night表示留宿；在朋友家过夜用staying最合适。

evidence.quote: travel a long (24) ........ to school each day

explanations.text: a long way表示很远的路程；transport不表示距离，mile为可数单位不能这样与a long搭配。

evidence.quote: This is (0) ........ best holiday ever!

explanations.text: best为最高级，前面使用定冠词the；此题是原书示例，不计分。

evidence.quote: Plakias is such (25) ........ beautiful place.

explanations.text: such a + 形容词 + 单数可数名词，place前需要不定冠词a。

evidence.quote: you can have as (26) ........ as you want

explanations.text: as much as you want表示想吃多少就吃多少，省略的食物量按不可数量处理。

evidence.quote: There’s lots for everyone in my family (27) ........ do

explanations.text: lots ... to do用不定式说明有许多事情可做。

evidence.quote: try windsurfing (28) ........ the first time

explanations.text: for the first time为固定短语，表示第一次。

evidence.quote: I (29) ........ never done it before

explanations.text: never done it before需要现在完成时，I后用have；原书同时给出缩写’ve。

evidence.quote: I (30) ........ like to come back next year

explanations.text: would like to表示想要；原书同时给出缩写’d。

samples.text:
Hi Malcolm,
I’m writing to you because I’m having a barbecue party this Saturday. Would you like to come? It’s at my house at 7 pm. Could you bring some crisps or some orange juice or something like that? That would be brilliant.
I hope to see you there.
Cheers,
Tommy

supplementaryComments.text: 范文分别说明聚会类型、时间和地点，发出邀请，并建议带薯片或橙汁；这些是任务点覆盖示例，不是唯一可接受答案，也不是官方分数。

evidence.quote: tell Malcolm about your party

taskGuidance.text: 至少25词。先交代聚会信息，再明确询问Malcolm是否愿意来，最后建议带什么。可用Would you like to ...?和Could you bring ...?。评分须由人工按已审核量表完成；原书范文未附分数。

samples.text: My sister and I were going home after school today when we saw something on the street. It was a lady’s handbag. We picked it up and found a name and phone number inside. My sister rang the number, and an old lady answered. My sister told her that we had found her bag. She told us where she lived, and so we took it to her house. ‘Thank you so much,’ she said. ‘I was looking for it everywhere!’

supplementaryComments.text: 范文依照发现手提包、打电话联系失主、送还手提包的顺序串联三幅图。人物姓名等可自行设定，但应保持图中事件关系；原书没有附范文得分。

evidence.quote: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

taskGuidance.text: 至少35词，并覆盖全部三幅图：路上发现手提包、根据包内信息联系失主、把包送还。用时间顺序连接事件，注意过去时和人物指代。图片尚未绑定，当前草稿不可用于正式作答。

evidence.quote: so ten past seven actually.

explanations.text: 女孩先猜7:30，但父亲查后更正为ten past seven，即7:10，对应B。6:30是前面的体育节目。

evidence.quote: She’s asking her friend Sarah, you know, our neighbour’s daughter

explanations.text: 妈妈说Diana正在问朋友Sarah数学作业，Sarah是邻居家的女儿，对应女孩图片C；不是姑姨或男同学。

evidence.quote: On that little table next to my bed would be great.

explanations.text: 问的是将把表放哪里。妈妈指定床旁小桌，对应A；厨房是发现手表的位置，沙发是她原先以为放表的地方。

evidence.quote: I walked all the way home because the bus was late. It took an hour!

explanations.text: 女孩累是因为公交晚点后步行一小时回家，对应C；她并未打网球，也还没帮忙整理房间。

evidence.quote: Isn’t it going to be cloudy on Sunday?

explanations.text: 对话谈周日会多云但温度约25度，对应A；下雨只是另一个男孩回忆度假游泳经历。

evidence.quote: This one’s in the Bridge Stadium. That’s B-R-I-D-G-E.

explanations.text: 地点改为Bridge Stadium，并逐字母拼写B-R-I-D-G-E；不是上次去的City Stadium。

evidence.quote: it’s better for us to get the three-nine-five

explanations.text: 274路半小时一班，建议搭十分钟一班的395路。原书写395 (any convention)；此草稿先登记数字395，文字写法待单独审核。

evidence.quote: we only pay four fifty each.

explanations.text: 通常票价£10，但父亲是俱乐部会员，本次每人实际只付£4.50；题面已印£，答案不再重复币种。

evidence.quote: you’ll need a coat.

explanations.text: 天气冷，讲话者明确说不要只穿jacket，要穿coat。

evidence.quote: bring a snack because the cafés are expensive.

explanations.text: 带零食是因为咖啡馆贵；水可以免费领取，所以不用带水。

evidence.quote: I went with the family who live next to us.

explanations.text: 住在隔壁的一家人就是邻居；同学去的是工厂，而不是城堡。

evidence.quote: Yeah, it rained, but I didn’t mind.

explanations.text: 参观那天下雨，因此wet；冷且刮风说的是今天，不是参观日。

evidence.quote:
especially the Queen’s bathroom.
Hitomi: Me too!

explanations.text: Freddie最喜欢王后的浴室，Hitomi用Me too表示同意；她觉得黄色卧室很奇怪。

evidence.quote: To get some information about wild birds.

explanations.text: Freddie明确说为了了解野鸟；拍照是他的爱好，遇见历史老师也不等于参观目的。

evidence.quote: next month, you can see some cars that are over fifty years old!

explanations.text: 旧车展示在下个月；赛跑在下周，绘画课程在明年夏天。

evidence.quote: The next bit was difficult though. I needed my mum to explain it to me!

explanations.text: 开头很清楚、最后也能理解，困难的是中间的next bit，需要妈妈解释。

evidence.quote: I’ve never heard music like that before or seen some of those instruments before.

explanations.text: 题目问男孩Tom的意见。他觉得演奏不错且音乐、乐器新奇，所以unusual；terrible是女孩的看法。

evidence.quote: Shall I phone mum now to say we’ll be at the café in the main square in 30 minutes?

explanations.text: 他们要到中心广场咖啡馆见妈妈；看球是出发前在家做的事，买报纸是请妈妈顺便做。

evidence.quote: we’re allowed to go to the park today!

explanations.text: 已有地理项目还缺照片，所以今天去公园上课；不是新项目，也没有说延长课时。

evidence.quote: Her husband travels a lot in his job, showing tourists round different cities.

explanations.text: 丈夫带游客参观不同城市，职业是导游；画画是Emma的工作，餐馆只说明住所位置。

evidence.quote: the hall was a long way from the rest of the school!

explanations.text: 原书示例中hall离学校其余部分很远，对应F；此示例不计分。

evidence.quote: you could always hear the traffic in the street outside or the crowds of people waiting for the buses.

explanations.text: 总能听到街道交通和等公交人群的声音，说明食堂嘈杂noisy；不是说食堂拥挤。

evidence.quote: dirty and not warm enough!

explanations.text: 图书馆脏，对应not clean；说不够暖并不等于选项too warm，也明确否定太小。

evidence.quote: they didn’t have the latest equipment.

explanations.text: 没有最新设备说明教室不现代，对应not modern。

evidence.quote: They were so slow, you could walk faster! I don’t know why we had them!

explanations.text: 电梯慢得不如走路，讲话者质疑它的用途，对应not useful。

evidence.quote: There wasn’t enough space for two desks and the bookshelves.

explanations.text: 容不下两张桌子和书架，说明办公室太小，对应too small。

reviewGuidance.text: 本Part是个人访谈，没有唯一正确答案。按考官脚本依次进行基本信息、季节与节日、食物两个主题；扩展回答应围绕个人经历作连贯说明。此说明为AI辅助补充，尚未审核，不代表官方评分等级。
记录候选人的实际回答后，由获授权成人依据经审核的口语量表评价语法词汇、发音、互动与整体表现；未批改不记零分。不得把示例国家Mexico当作应答答案。
围绕图中的动作片、新闻、足球、歌唱和历史节目交流喜好并说明理由；注意回应同伴而非分别背诵独白。考官可使用脚本中的追问。没有统一喜好或唯一正确答案。
第二阶段谈独自或与他人看电视的偏好，以及一周不同日子看电视的时间。可接受个人真实答案；本草稿不生成官方分数。

blocks.text: Track 55 · Listening Part 1 · Questions 1–5

1 What time does the nature programme start?
Dad: Are you going to watch the nature programme after dinner tonight, Catherine?
Catherine: Yes, I think it begins at seven thirty, doesn’t it, dad?
Dad: Let me check ... Oh, it’s on just after the six-thirty sports programme, so ten past seven actually. We can have dinner earlier than usual if you like.
Catherine: Great!

2 Who is Diana talking to on her mobile?
Boy: Mum, who’s Diana phoning? Is she calling Aunt Christine about borrowing her bike?
Mum: She’s asking her friend Sarah, you know, our neighbour’s daughter, about some maths homework. Have you done your homework?
Boy: I’m doing a project with David, remember? He’s coming a bit later so that we can work here.
Mum: Oh, yes. You did tell me about David.

3 Where will Henry put his mum’s watch?
Henry: Mum, is this your watch here next to the cooker?
Mum: Oh, yes! Thank you, Henry, I was looking for it a minute ago in the sitting room. I thought it was on the sofa.
Henry: Shall I leave it in the kitchen or put it in your bedroom?
Mum: On that little table next to my bed would be great.
Henry: OK.

4 Why is the girl tired?
Girl: I think I’ll go to bed early tonight.
Boy: Yeah, you look tired. Did you play tennis with Jane after school?
Girl: She played with someone else. I walked all the way home because the bus was late. It took an hour!
Boy: Wow! But can you help me tidy my bedroom?
Girl: Erm, sorry!

5 What will the weather be like on Sunday?
Boy 1: I’m going swimming in the lake on Sunday with my mum and dad. Do you want to come?
Boy 2: Isn’t it going to be cloudy on Sunday?
Boy 1: That doesn’t matter because it’ll be about 25 degrees. Mum checked the temperature.
Boy 2: Oh, OK then. I went swimming when it was raining on holiday. It was really funny!
Track 56 · Part 2 · Questions 6–10

Emin: Hi. I’m phoning about the football match that we’re going to. It’s on Saturday. But it isn’t in the City Stadium like the last football match we went to. This one’s in the Bridge Stadium. That’s B-R-I-D-G-E. You know, near the river!

Can you come to my house at half past two? Then we can go to the match together by bus. Bus number two-seven-four only goes every thirty minutes, so it’s better for us to get the three-nine-five, which is every ten minutes.
The tickets are usually ten pounds, but because my dad’s a member of the football club, we only pay four fifty each. That’s not bad, is it?
It’s going to be a bit cold, so don’t wear just a jacket—you’ll need a coat. I’m going to wear my red one because that’s our team’s colour!
Oh, and another thing, bring a snack because the cafés are expensive. You can get water there for free, so don’t bring water.
I think that’s everything. Bye!
Track 57 · Part 3 · Questions 11–15

Hitomi: Hi, Freddie. I went to Hardin Castle on Saturday.
Freddie: Did you go with your family or was it a class trip, Hitomi?
Hitomi: My class visited a factory. I went with the family who live next to us.
Freddie: But the weather wasn’t good on Saturday ...
Hitomi: Yeah, it rained, but I didn’t mind. It wasn’t cold and windy like today. Today’s worse!
Freddie: I went to Hardin Castle last year. I saw the dining room ... but I liked upstairs better, especially the Queen’s bathroom.
Hitomi: Me too! I thought the yellow bedroom was strange. Why did you go to the castle? Was it to take photos? I know that’s your hobby.

Freddie: To get some information about wild birds. And I saw my history teacher when I was there!
Hitomi: Did you talk to him?
Freddie: Yes. There are lots of interesting things to do at the castle. Next week, there’s a race. You have to run five kilometres. Then, next month, you can see some cars that are over fifty years old!
Hitomi: Do they do painting courses?
Freddie: The next one’s next summer!
Track 58 · Part 4 · Questions 16–20

16 You will hear a girl talking about a video. Which part of the video didn’t she understand?
Millie: I liked that film about animals that live in the Amazon Forest. It started by showing the different places different animals like to live in, and all that bit was clear. The next bit was difficult though. I needed my mum to explain it to me! Then the last part was good and I didn’t have any problems understanding it.

17 You will hear two friends talking about a concert. What’s the boy’s opinion of the concert?
Jess: I didn’t like the school concert yesterday, mainly because the musicians hadn’t practised enough. They were really bad, I think.
Tom: Really? I think they played well, but I’ve never heard music like that before or seen some of those instruments before.
Jess: It must be interesting to play new stuff, I guess.
Tom: Exactly! Doing the same thing’s awful.

18 You will hear a boy talking to his dad about going to the city centre. Why are they going to the city centre?
Boy: When are we going to the city centre?
Dad: I just want to see the end of this football match. Then, we can go.
Boy: Shall I phone mum now to say we’ll be at the café in the main square in 30 minutes?
Dad: Yes, please. And could you ask her to get today’s newspaper for me?
Boy: Sure.

19 You will hear a teacher talking to his class. What information is he giving his students?
Man: Listen, everyone. Because you still need some photos to add to your geography project, we’re allowed to go to the park today! I know you love working there, but you must still make sure you do your school work carefully. We’re coming back to the classroom at ten, so that we have time to put everything away.

20 You will hear a boy talking about his sister, Emma. Who has Emma married?
Boy: My sister Emma got married last week to a guy she met in Paris. And now she lives in an apartment above that restaurant called Marco’s in Green Street. She finished studying art and design last year and has just got a job drawing pictures for a book! Her husband travels a lot in his job, showing tourists round different cities.
Track 59 · Part 5 · Questions 21–25

Angela: Uncle Edward, we’re moving into our new school next month. They’ve built it next to the old one.
Edward: Fantastic! There were some problems with your old one, weren’t there?
Angela: Yes, like the hall was a long way from the rest of the school!
Edward: But what was wrong with the cafeteria?
Angela: Well, you could always hear the traffic in the street outside or the crowds of people waiting for the buses.
Edward: Oh, OK. And your library?
Angela: It wasn’t too small or anything like that, just ... dirty and not warm enough!
Edward: But were the classrooms OK?
Angela: Yeah..., my class used the ones on the second floor, but they didn’t have the latest equipment.
Edward: That’s a pity. Was there a lift?
Angela: They were so slow, you could walk faster! I don’t know why we had them!
Edward: I went to your school office once.
Angela: There wasn’t enough space for two desks and the bookshelves. But the secretary liked it and said the shelves were quite useful.
Edward: Oh.
